border.$description: Semantic border colors. Border *width* tokens live in primitive/border.json. Top key dropped the `.color` infix in v2 — emit as `--scout-border-*`.

knockout.$description: Legacy alias kept for components that still reference it; prefer `border.inverse` on dark surfaces.

inverse.$description: Border drawn on top of inverse / dark surfaces (snackbar, tile splits).

teal.$description: Teal border paired with `fill.teal` — used by share-with-customer surfaces.
